say:1:1033503001:1.text: Really? That's great. This has plagued us for too long already.
say:1:1033503001:1.source_cn: 真的呀？那太好了，这事已经困扰我们很久了。
say:1:1033503001:1.male: Really? That's great. This has plagued us for too long already.

say:2:1033503002:1.text: To be honest, the corruption is so severe that even the Wilders don't really come to worship the Lucent Tree anymore, alas...
say:2:1033503002:1.source_cn: 说句实话，腐化这么严重，连绿裔都不怎么过来朝拜流荧树了...

say:2:1033503002:1.female: To be honest, the corruption is so severe that even the Wilders don't really come to worship the Lucent Tree anymore, alas...

say:3:1033503003:1.text: The Lucent Tree will definitely be happy if peace can be restored in the forest.
say:3:1033503003:1.source_cn: 要是能让丛林恢复往常的平静，流荧树一定会很高兴的。
